Here, the influence of mechanical process parameters on the production of Li6PS5Cl and LiNi0.83Co0.11Mn0.06O2 composite cathodes applying a planetary ball milling process is systematically investigated.

title: Clinicopathological features and prognosis of patients with HER2-low breast cancer
creator: Xin Yang, Yao Li, Xu lu, Xiaotian Ren, Bin Hua

BackgroundLow human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) expression is an emerging concept in breast cancer that is defined as immunohistochemistry (IHC) 1 + or IHC 2 + and negative in situ hybridization (ISH) but has been poorly investigated.

title: Genomic stewardship in Alzheimer’s disease: a decade of insights from the NIAGADS platform

title: Self‐Assembly of Bent‐Core Nematics in Nanopores

When confined in nanopores, they can stabilize chiral nanostructures, enhance polar order, and enable defect‐driven switching – offering potential in nanofluidics, sensing, and adaptive optics.

title: Understanding multi-azole resistance in Aspergillus fumigatus: the impact of non-cyp51A mutation and efflux pump overexpression

The present study aimed to investigate azole resistance mechanisms, focusing on non-cyp51A mutations and efflux pump genes overexpression in environmental isolates of A. fumigatus.MethodsA total of 156 soil samples collected from 13 states across India were screened for azole-resistant A. fumigatus isolates.

title: Social inequalities and COVID-19 mortality between neighborhoods of Bariloche city, Argentina

description: IntroductionImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) targeting cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-associated antigen-4 (CTLA-4) and programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) have revolutionised treatment and improved outcomes in various malignancies. creator: João Silvestre Silva-Junior, Maria Carmen Martinez, Felipe Seiti Sekiya, Cristiano Barreto de Miranda, Frida Marina Fischer

They are the leading cause of years lived with disability. The aim of this study was to analyze the factors that influence the return to work (RTW) among workers on sick leave due to MSDI.

title: Odontogenic Keratocyst of the Maxilla With Fungal Sinusitis: A Rare Case
creator: Amrinder Singh, Rishabh Kasrija, Ajay Mittal, Ankush Gupta, Harmandeep Kaur
description: Odontogenic keratocysts (OKCs) in the maxilla are rare. Although destructive, their clinical presentation can mimic inflammatory conditions like radicular cysts and osteomyelitis. description: That need has brought us in a new era of lipid-lowering therapies (LLTs), which is the focus of this Research Topic. In their short review, Mercep et al. examine the role of PCSK9 inhibitors, summarizing findings from numerous meta-analyses and real-world studies (Mercep et al.).

title: Gitelman Syndrome Presenting With Syncope and Treatment‐Refractory Hypokalemia in A Young Woman: A Case Report
creator: Iyassu S. Melkie, Abenezer A. Wolde, Lulit Y. Mengesha, Rahwa A. Kinfe, Chernet T. Mengistie, Zenebwork Y. Gubai
description: Gitelman syndrome (GS) is a rare autosomal recessive tubulopathy characterized by hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis, hypomagnesemia, and hypocalciuria. A 27‐year‐old woman presented with a witnessed syncopal episode, progressive weakness, and nausea. title: Support in acute situations when a community health nurse is called: experiences of older patients, their significant others, and involved healthcare professionals- a qualitative interview study
creator: Elin-Sofie Forsgärde, Mattias Rööst, Anders Svensson, Bengt Fridlund, Carina Elmqvist
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundCare decisions for older patients in acute situations are challenging to make, and there is limited knowledge of support in home healthcare settings, where older patients receive ongoing health care from, for example, community health nurses.
